title: Kaisay Galay Pe Tere Khanjar Mein
body:
kaisay galay pe tere khanjar mein chalta dekhoon, aakhir Hussain maan hoon…
Gardan pe rakhe teri,x2  apna gala kataa doon, aakhir Hussain maan hoon…
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Jab zeen se giro tum kahin chot lag na jae.
maqtal ki sar zameen se x2  pathar toh main hataadoon akhir Hussain….
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Momin jo kar rahe hai din raat Hussain ka gham.
kaisay main matami ko x2  jannat mein bhool jaoo, akhir Hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Chaaron taraf se zaalim barsa rahe thay pathar
nazak badan mein kese x2 zakhmon say choor dekhu, akhir Hussain…
